subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as a live repository policy notice now that current docs and automation already encode the 20-PR cap?
rationale: The code/docs side is complete, but the issue was deliberately renamed, repinned, and reopened after implementation, so retiring it is an admin/product-communication choice rather than a source cleanup decision.

options.title: Keep Open As Notice
options.body: Leave the issue open and pinned while the PR-limit policy needs prominent contributor-facing visibility beyond CONTRIBUTING.md.

options.title: Retire To Docs Only
options.body: Close or unpin the issue and rely on CONTRIBUTING.md plus Barnacle auto-response comments as the canonical contributor guidance.

recommendation.title: Keep Open As Notice
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and pinned while the PR-limit policy needs prominent contributor-facing visibility beyond CONTRIBUTING.md.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the live issue-status changes and also aligned the docs cap to 20, making them the clearest owner for the visibility decision.
